lines.text: Moses goes up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, and the LORD shows him the whole land.
The LORD says He swore this land to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and that Moses will not cross into it.
Moses dies in the land of Moab, and the LORD buries him in a valley facing Bethel.
Moses dies at a hundred and ten years old, and the Israelites grieve for him in the plains of Moab.
Joshua is filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses laid his hands on him, and the Israelites obey him.
